meta.description: RAA Journey Management — queryable by Slack bot

journeys.name: Home Insurance Quote to Buy
journeys.description: End-to-end flow for obtaining a home and/or contents insurance quote and purchasing a policy online.

touchpoints.name: Quote Entry
touchpoints.description: User lands on quote start page, accepts legal notices, and selects cover type (Home & Contents, Home only, Contents only).

touchpoints.name: Address Lookup
touchpoints.description: User searches and confirms their home address via autocomplete lookup.

touchpoints.name: Home Occupancy & Use
touchpoints.description: User describes how the property is used (owner-occupied, holiday home, unoccupied) and number of occupants.

touchpoints.name: Building Details
touchpoints.description: User enters construction details: building type, wall material, roof material, and year built.

touchpoints.name: Contents Cover & Extras
touchpoints.description: User sets contents sum insured and selects optional covers such as accidental damage and valuable items.

touchpoints.name: Quote Review & Purchase
touchpoints.description: User reviews quote price, adjusts excess, confirms policy holder details, and completes payment.

journeys.name: Roadside Assistance Callout
journeys.description: Member requests roadside assistance via the RAA app or phone when their vehicle breaks down.

touchpoints.name: Emergency Login
touchpoints.description: Member opens the RAA app and authenticates to access roadside assistance services.

touchpoints.name: Request Assistance
touchpoints.description: Member taps Request Roadside Assistance, confirms location via GPS or manual entry, and describes the breakdown.

touchpoints.name: Phone Triage
touchpoints.description: If app is unavailable or member prefers, they call the RAA roadside hotline and speak to a dispatcher.

touchpoints.name: Live ETA Tracking
touchpoints.description: Member views real-time patrol location on a map and receives push notifications as the patrol approaches.

touchpoints.name: Service Completion
touchpoints.description: Patrol marks job complete; member receives a summary notification and is prompted to rate the experience.

journeys.name: Fuel Price Search
journeys.description: Member uses the RAA app to find the cheapest local fuel price and navigate to the station.

touchpoints.name: Fuel Finder Entry
touchpoints.description: Member opens the Fuel Prices section from the RAA app home screen or bottom navigation.

touchpoints.name: Location & Fuel Type Filter
touchpoints.description: Member sets search radius and selects fuel type (Unleaded, Diesel, E10, Premium). Results list by price.

touchpoints.name: Station Detail View
touchpoints.description: Member taps a station to see current price, last updated time, address, and trading hours.

touchpoints.name: Navigate to Station
touchpoints.description: Member taps Get Directions and is handed off to Apple Maps or Google Maps with the station pre-loaded.

journeys.name: RAA Membership Renewal
journeys.description: Existing member receives renewal notice and completes annual membership renewal across web and app channels.

touchpoints.name: Renewal Notice Email
touchpoints.description: Member receives automated renewal reminder email 30 days before expiry with a link to renew online.

touchpoints.name: Membership Summary Review
touchpoints.description: Member logs into My Account and views current membership tier, expiry date, and renewal price.

touchpoints.name: Tier & Add-ons Selection
touchpoints.description: Member can upgrade membership tier or add services such as home assist or caravan cover.

touchpoints.name: App Renewal Prompt
touchpoints.description: RAA app surfaces a renewal banner when membership is within 14 days of expiry, with one-tap renewal for saved payment methods.

touchpoints.name: Payment & Confirmation
touchpoints.description: Member completes payment via saved card or BPAY and receives an instant confirmation email with updated membership card.

journeys.name: Car Insurance Quote
journeys.description: Prospective customer or existing member obtains a comprehensive car insurance quote online.

touchpoints.name: Vehicle Lookup
touchpoints.description: User enters their vehicle registration or selects make, model, and year to identify the insured vehicle.

touchpoints.name: Driver Details
touchpoints.description: User enters primary and additional driver details including age, licence type, and driving history.

touchpoints.name: Vehicle Use & Storage
touchpoints.description: User specifies annual kilometres, primary use (personal/business), and overnight storage location.

touchpoints.name: Cover Options
touchpoints.description: User selects cover type (Comprehensive, Third Party Fire & Theft, Third Party) and optional extras.

touchpoints.name: Quote & Purchase
touchpoints.description: User reviews quote with member and multi-policy discounts applied, adjusts excess, and proceeds to buy.
